The Director

Made by someone who does the work.

I'm Steve Nooshinfar, a Dubai-based creative director with more than 15 years in motion graphics, editing, visual effects and colour. I started out as a video editor, long before AI tools existed.

Today I plan, generate and finish AI-assisted advertising work as part of my day-to-day job. These books write down the process I actually use — the same decisions, shown on real projects.

Trained through School of Motion, Rebelway and Motion Design School; a background running creative teams as an animation supervisor. This is the playbook I wish I'd had.
